components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single primary command on a focused surface.
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; height: 2.25rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: #DC822E; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #D07A2B; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #C26D24; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(220 130 46 / 0.35); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Action Button
components.description: Established slate action hierarchy where the shared action variant owns the workflow.
components.css: .ds-button-action { display: inline-flex; height: 2.25rem; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; border: 0; border-radius: 0.75rem; background: #3B4C63; color: #FFFFFF; padding: 0.5rem 1rem; font: 500 0.875rem/1.25 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 150ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-button-action:hover { background: #354459; } .ds-button-action:active { background: #2F3D50; transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-button-action:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid rgb(59 76 99 / 0.3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: A quiet bordered field with clear focus and error recovery.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; color: #18181B; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-label { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 2.75rem; border: 1px solid #B8B8B8; border-radius: 0.375rem; background: #FFFFFF; color: #18181B; padding: 0.25rem 1rem; font: 400 0.875rem/1.5 Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), box-shadow 100ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #89898F; } .ds-input:focus-visible { border-color: #DC822E; outline: 3px solid rgb(220 130 46 / 0.2); outline-offset: 0; }

components.name: Compact Menu
components.description: Two to five direct commands in the blessed dropdown density.
components.css: .ds-menu { width: 14rem; border: 1px solid #E6E6E6; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: #FFFFFF; padding: 0.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.04); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-menu-item { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 2rem; align-items: center; border: 0; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: transparent; color: #18181B; padding: 0.375rem 0.5rem; text-align: left; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25; } .ds-menu-item:hover, .ds-menu-item:focus-visible { background: #F2F2F2; outline: none; } .ds-menu-danger { color: #B91D1D; } .ds-menu-separator { height: 1px; margin: 0.25rem; background: #E6E6E6; }

components.name: Open Section
components.description: The default page-section hierarchy without a wrapper card.
components.html:

components.css: .ds-section { display: grid; gap: 1rem; color: #18181B; font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-section-heading { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 1rem; } .ds-section-heading h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-section-heading button { border: 0; background: transparent; color: #606262; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-section-heading button:hover, .ds-section-heading button:focus-visible { color: #18181B; text-decoration: underline; outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-section-content { border-top: 1px solid #E6E6E6; padding-top: 1rem; color: #606262; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.5; }

narrative.overview: Alleato is quiet, precise, and operator-grade. Familiar patterns, stable density, restrained color, and direct language keep construction teams focused on the current state, the next correct action, and supporting evidence.

rules.name: The Reuse Gate
rules.body: Inspect and reuse the canonical owner before creating or copying UI.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Orange communicates action, selection, or state. It never decorates.

rules.name: The Flat-by-Default Rule
rules.body: Use content order, typography, spacing, alignment, and dividers before containers or shadows.

rules.name: The Copy Economy Rule
rules.body: Do not restate titles or obvious mechanics. Copy must add constraint, consequence, source, or recovery.

dos: Do design for execution, correction, and source-backed trust.
Do use semantic tokens and shared primitives.
Do preserve momentum and user input through failure.
Do make empty and error states recoverable.
donts: Don't reproduce Procore-style clutter or gray-on-gray enterprise noise.
Don't use generic admin-template dashboards, stat-card rows, or filler summaries.
Don't use playful consumer styling or decoration that competes with operator trust.
Don't create one-off feature styling, nested cards, or page-level wrapper cards.
Don't ship silent failures, generic errors, or read-only workflows that look actionable.
